prior_credit.essential_import: Ashwin Sah and Mehtaab Sawhney, Local limit theorems for subgraph counts, arXiv:2006.11369v1, Theorem 1.1 and Section 5
prior_credit.historical_question: Alex Scott, joint work with Atsushi Tateno, On the Number of Triangles in a Random Graph, OWR 23/2009, printed pp.1279–1280
prior_credit.disconnected_obstruction_credit: Sah–Sawhney, Theorem 1.3: ordinary-unlabeled 2K2 Gaussian LLT obstruction

related_target_overlap.relation: The adjacent all-fixed-subgraph modular/LLT question overlaps this coverage and the credited 2K2 obstruction.

accepted_claims: For fixed p in (0,1), ordinary unlabeled triangles T in G(n,p), and every positive integer sequence q_n, max_a|q_n P(T=a mod q_n)-1| tends to zero if and only if q_n=o(n^2).
The exact variance is binom(n,3)p^3(1-p^3)+12binom(n,4)p^5(1-p), asymptotic to p^5(1-p)n^4/2. Sigma is its positive square root.
The imported density LLT implies the original Gaussian cell-mass LLT. Concentration and finite-window summation give sufficiency; an independent CLT and modular Fourier obstruction give necessity.
The credited ordinary-unlabeled 2K2 example has an atom Omega_p(n^(-5/2)) and standard deviation Theta_p(n^3), excluding a uniform Gaussian LLT.
interpretation_caveats: p is fixed in (0,1); no sparse or endpoint-varying-p theorem.
The nondegenerate sigma-normalized argument starts at n>=3.
Triangles are counted once with span one; labeled embeddings 6T require a different modular statement.
All residues and every positive integer sequence are covered, including q=1, bounded, composite, oscillating, arbitrarily slowly subcritical, critical and supercritical moduli.
The quantitative pointwise Sah–Sawhney LLT is imported; its deep Fourier/decoupling proof is not fully reconstructed.
The shifted-mesh lemma assumes f in L1 and integrable derivative; this repair is retained.
The independent audit checks core triangle mathematics, source premise, density/cell convention and 2K2 reconstruction, not every peripheral literature-table assertion.
Berkowitz defects are scoped to the identified displays of the retained byte-pinned v3 PDF, without an all-versions claim or whole-paper rejection.
Connected, induced, disconnected and joint counts have different hypotheses; no unrestricted classification is asserted.
Overlap with 30001249 is credited coverage, not a separate discovery.
